knowledge_point.title: Finding an Integral Expression for Flux

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vector field $F(x,y)=(- 24 x^{2} y^{2})\,i+(- 12 x^{3} y)\,j$ and the circle $C$ given by ${x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=4.$ If the flux of $F$ across $C$ is given by  

$$
{∮}_{C}\boxed{}\,\text{d}s,
$$

what is the missing expression?

*Hint: The outward-pointing unit normal vector to $C$ is $n=\frac{x}{2}\,i+\frac{y}{2}\,j.$*
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $F$ is a vector field and $C$ is a piecewise-smooth, simple, closed curve, then the flux of $F$ across $C$ is given by

$$
{∮}_{C}F\cdot n\,\text{d}s,
$$

where $n$ denotes the outward-pointing unit normal vector to $C.$

![](images/ff/ff84680c55f5349431cf3d70066eeaba2c680569faa3b2210e5d14ef63ccd99e.png)

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{∮}_{C}F\cdot n\,\text{d}s & ={∮}_{C}((- 24 x^{2} y^{2})\,i+(- 12 x^{3} y)\,j)\cdot (\frac{x}{2}\,i+\frac{y}{2}\,j)\,\text{d}s \\  & ={∮}_{C}- 12 x^{3} y^{2}-6 x^{3} y^{2}\,\text{d}s \\  & ={∮}_{C}- 18 x^{3} y^{2}\,\text{d}s.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the missing expression is $- 18 x^{3} y^{2}.$

generation.domains: x,y real; circle radius positive; outward normal as supplied or shown
generation.generalization: One nonzero integer scales the entire field and complete observed bank; geometry fixed.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the vector field $F(x,y)=(- 6 x y)\,i+(2 x^{2})\,j$ and the circle $C$ given by ${x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=1.$ If the flux of $F$ across $C$ is given by

$$
{∮}_{C}\boxed{}\,\text{d}s,
$$

what is the missing expression?

*Hint: The outward-pointing unit normal vector to $C$ is $n=x\,i+y\,j.$*
question.:question/worked-solution:
If $F$ is a vector field and $C$ is a piecewise-smooth, simple, closed curve, then the flux of $F$ across $C$ is given by

$$
{∮}_{C}F\cdot n\,\text{d}s,
$$

where $n$ denotes the outward-pointing unit normal vector to $C.$

![](images/38/386f010932b5846e7f47a605a94a5b5d580bd35dbe37512b1583d15d29f3dc70.png)

In our case, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{∮}_{C}F\cdot n\,\text{d}s & ={∮}_{C}((- 6 x y)\,i+(2 x^{2})\,j)\cdot (x\,i+y\,j)\,\text{d}s \\  & ={∮}_{C}- 6 x^{2} y+2 x^{2} y\,\text{d}s \\  & ={∮}_{C}- 4 x^{2} y\,\text{d}s.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the missing expression is $- 4 x^{2} y.$
